note: Cross-game radio manifest — the shared dial. 8 DSDA Radio broadcast shows: Most Pit FM 73.7 (death/doom metal, CC0), Jungle Massive FM 88.3 (jungle/DnB, CC BY), Easy Mellow FM 92.5 (bossa/lounge, CC BY 4.0), 103.7 Chip FM (8-bit chiptunes, CC0), Artificial Black FM 113.7 (dark electronic/glitch, artist tracks), Z107.7 Classic Rock (CC BY 4.0), Tripped Up FM 127.5 (jazz/triphop, CC0), Mental FM 137.7 (electronic). Stations are sorted by frequency so the tuning dial reads low->high. Station types: 'broadcast' (live clock — tune in mid-song, everyone on the same second; points at a manifest.json with a program), 'stream' (Polkahole), 'seamless' (the games' own 1-track originals).
